verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover only fragments of a lockout-recovery story. You can remove a lost key from your account (docs-9), and resetting a Bluetooth key keeps it registered (docs-8). The backup-key practice appears only secondhand: a community post says Google's guidelines recommend storing one key safely and using the other daily (comm-3), and another notes the kit ships with two keys as a backup (comm-5). Missing for 10: first-party documentation on registering a backup key, an explicit statement of what is and is not recoverable after loss, account-recovery fallback paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of a recovery flow.
